# Project adapters

_nextop 0.1.3_

An adapter connects an outside engine to nextop through a fixed contract: an LLM vendor, a search index engine
(a vector or graph search library) or an embedding service. The core has only the contracts and two built-in adapters
(`nextop.adapters.openai_compat:OpenAICompatLLM`, `nextop.adapters.http_embed:JsonEmbed`). Anything else is one
file here, `adapters/<file>.py`, chosen in project.json by kind and name:

```json
"adapters": {
  "index": { "graph": { "class": "adapters.graph_index:GraphIndex", "options": { "model": "...", "embed": "lan" } } }
}
```

- `options` are passed to `__init__` as keyword arguments; a relative `env_file` is resolved against this project.
- Keys stay in `.env`: take the variable name as an option (`key_env`) and read the value yourself; never log it.
- The file is found in this project folder (like tools and functions). Imports of outside libraries go inside the
  methods or at the top, as you like; install those libraries next to nextop (`pip install ...`).
- Workers and file servers name an index entry: `"knowledge": {"index": "graph"}`, `"index": "graph"`.

## Contracts (only these methods are needed)

```python
from nextop.adapters import Reply, ToolCall, Item, Passage, IndexStats, LLMError

class MyLLM:                      # kind "llm"
    def chat(self, model, messages, tools=None) -> Reply: ...   # Reply(text=..., tool_calls=[ToolCall(id, name, arguments)], raw=...)
    def supports(self, model, feature) -> bool: ...             # feature e.g. "vision"
    # raise LLMError(message, retryable=True|False) on failures

class MyEmbed:                    # kind "embed"
    def embed(self, texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]]: ...

class MyIndex:                    # kind "index"
    def build(self, workdir, items: list[Item], cache_dir) -> IndexStats: ...     # new index in workdir
    def assemble(self, workdir, items: list[Item], cache_dir) -> IndexStats: ... # rebuild for fewer items, no LLM calls
    def query(self, workdir, question) -> list[Passage]: ...                      # retrieve only, never answer
    # optional: insert(workdir, items, cache_dir) / delete(workdir, item_addresses) for quick updates;
    # build(..., on_progress=None) gets on_progress(done, total) when the signature has it
```

- Every text part of an item is indexed under the address `<item.address>#<part name>`; `query()` returns
  `Passage(address, text, score)` with those addresses and the original text.
- Optional on any adapter: `bind(adapters)` is called after all adapters exist, so an index can use an embedding
  entry by name (`"embed": "lan"` -> `adapters["embed"]["lan"]`); `check()` returns a list of problems for `nextop check`.
- Full example adapters are in the nextop source under `examples/adapters/` (an index engine with a local
  embedding); copy one here and adapt it.
